* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; the AI printing shares the text of slip 02)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 1 April 2010, first printing not found)</ref>: “Once during opponent’s activate phase, may relocate Aurra to same site as a Jedi. Once per game, during your move phase, may fire her weapon at a Jedi; hit target is lost. Immune to attrition < 4.” The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> That copy is a stale reprint, not a version (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Aurra Sing (V) (AI) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013), for “Aurra Sing (V) (AI)”, changed “relocate Aurra to same site as a Jedi” to “relocate Aurra to a site where opponent has a Jedi”: “Once during opponent's activate phase, may relocate Aurra to a site where opponent has a Jedi. Once per game, during your move phase, may fire her weapon at a Jedi; hit target is lost. Immune to attrition < 4.”<ref name="cl-1250_2ai-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013)</ref>
